Sophie (People Ops): Heads up — annual privacy & security attestations are due Friday May 17th, 23:59 UTC. Please complete the online privacy/security training and upload your team's evidence artifacts to the Compliance Drive: https://redwood.internal/drive/compliance/2026-attestations

Checklist (high level):
- Training completion certificates
- Access matrix & runbooks
- Change management tickets (last 12 months)
- Vendor contracts with DPA where applicable
- Logs/retention proof for scoped services

Please assign a single attestation owner for your team in the shared spreadsheet and drop any blockers here by EOD Tuesday. We'll schedule spot checks next week. Questions? :wave:

ComplianceBot: Reminder scheduled: 2 weeks, 72h, 24h, 1h before deadline. Training module: https://redwood.internal/training/privacy-security-2026

Priya (Eng-SRE): How strict on 'logs' — do you need raw export or summary? :thinking:

Alex (Security): Summary exports are ok for most items. For SOC2 scoped services we need raw logs with provenance (timestamps + UUIDs). Please redact secrets before upload. Use secure portal.

Sasha (Eng-Platform): I'll take ownership for Platform. Will collect runbooks + access matrix. :white_check_mark:

Jared (SRE): We're ~70% there for infra services. Will paste location in spreadsheet shortly.

Nina (Legal): Quick reminder — do NOT upload keys/secrets into the Drive. If evidence contains secrets, use the secure upload portal and note that in the spreadsheet column 'secure_upload'.

Priya (Eng-SRE): Example command for log export (GCP):
```
gcloud logging read "resource.type=gce_instance AND logName=projects/redwood/logs/compute.googleapis.com%2Fserial" --limit=20000 --format=json > /tmp/service-logs.json
```

Maya (Audit): Heads-up — audit team will pick 2 services per org for deeper review next Thursday. Owners please add 'audit_ready' tag in spreadsheet.

Sophie (People Ops): If your team needs help compiling evidence, ping me or schedule a 30m slot here: https://cal.redwood.com/sophie/compliance

Priya (Eng-SRE): Is there any wiggle room on deadline for teams with on-call constraints? Some rotations next week are packed.

Sophie (People Ops): Try to avoid extensions; if absolutely needed, DM me with a short justification. We can approve emergency 3-day grace only with Exec sign-off.

ComplianceBot: Training completion counts will be visible in the spreadsheet by tomorrow morning.

Sasha (Eng-Platform): Added 'attestation_owner' = sasha@redwood to spreadsheet for Platform.

Jared (SRE): Posted link to infra evidence: https://redwood.internal/drive/compliance/infra/attestation-evidence

Maya (Audit): Thanks all — ping me if you want a pre-check before submit.

Sophie (People Ops): Thanks everyone. Final reminder will go out 72/24/1h. :rocket:
